texts.text:
Drinks in tune
with the planet.
A 100% non-alcoholic house of brands — spring water, sparkling citrus, botanical sodas, natural energy and cold-brew tea — bottled in 11 hubs across 42 markets.

slides.notes: 38-year story timeline. Five milestones from 1987 spring water to today's five-brand house.

texts.text: A house of brands built entirely without alcohol — by conviction, not by omission.
The Costa family bottles a limestone spring in the Sierra Calderona and sells it to Valencia beach cafés from one van.
Solara launches — Valencia oranges pressed within 72 hours of harvest. The citrus house becomes a beverage house.
Verda brings Mediterranean botanicals to fine-dining zero-proof lists. Water-positive pledge work begins.
Pulse (2019) and Origen (2021) complete the house. B-Corp certified; water-positive at 120% replenishment.
Sharjah and Tangerang hubs open. The 100% non-alcoholic portfolio becomes the growth engine in GCC and ASEAN.
Today: €1.9B revenue · 42 markets · 11 hubs · 4,800 people · five brands, zero alcohol

texts.text: 42 markets across three regions — EMEA anchors the base, APAC carries the growth.
EMEA — 20 markets. Spain, France, Germany, UK, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Morocco, Türkiye.
Americas — 10 markets. Brazil, Mexico, USA, Canada, Chile, Colombia.
APAC — 12 markets. Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, Australia.

These markets grew 28% in FY2025 — more than double group average — because Meridian's 100% non-alcoholic, halal-certified portfolio is the default premium choice for family occasions, Ramadan gifting and faith-conscious hospitality. Pipeline: 2,400 new listings confirmed for FY2026.

slides.notes: Category strategy per brand: one line of strategic intent each, with lifecycle stage.

texts.text: Defend the core, ride the growth curves, seed the next decade.
MERIDIAN SPRINGS · DEFEND — Premiumise: glass return systems in 8 EU cities, sommelier programme to 4,000 doors, Gulf hospitality listings.
SOLARA · MONETISE — The family-occasion toast: Gulf Ramadan gifting packs, share-packs for Iberia/LatAm retail, zero-sugar line extension 2026.
VERDA · EXPAND — Fine-dining zero-proof credibility in premium grocery; new botanicals from Alpujarra and Serra da Estrela.
PULSE · SCALE — +34% CAGR since 2021: natural caffeine, no taurine; push US Southwest and GCC convenience while staying clean-label.
ORIGEN · SEED — Brew culture: single-estate storytelling, tea sommeliers, 16-hour cold-brew bars in Madrid, Dubai and São Paulo.
Portfolio rule: every strategy must hold at a family table and in a Michelin dining room — without a drop of alcohol.

texts.text: Water-positive since 2021 · B-Corp recertified 2024 · audited and published, gaps included.
Water replenished vs used — 2.9bn litres returned in FY2025; AWS Gold at 6 hubs.
rPET share of plastic today → 100% by January 2027. No virgin PET in any line from then.
Solar generated FY2025 (14.2 MWp installed); 41% of daytime production energy.

2027 — 100% rPET; 50% glass return in the Americas.    2028 — all 11 hubs AWS Gold.    2029 — regenerative agriculture on 2,000 hectares.    2030 — Scope 1+2 −75% vs 2019; Scope 3 measured at ingredient level (today's honest gap).

slides.notes: Innovation pipeline: functional botanicals, regenerative groves, zero-waste press, Gulf zero-proof craft.

texts.text: Four programmes, one filter: would a family pour it?
Calm and energy lines under Verda: lemon-verbena L-theanine, saffron citrus. Zero sugar, zero alcohol, zero gimmicks.
2,000 hectares converted by 2030 with 214 grower partners; a soil-carbon programme that pays growers per hectare, not per promise.
Peel and pulp become essential oils, pectin and cattle feed: 94% of fruit mass valorised today, 100% target 2027.
A premium zero-proof sparkling range co-developed with Emirati and Malaysian hospitality groups — grown from our right to exist: 100% non-alcoholic, halal-certified, made for celebration.

Values we report against — including the misses

We are a 100% non-alcoholic company by conviction — it is our identity, our market advantage and our duty of care. We publish an annual water ledger and sustainability letter with our gaps named in plain text: two hubs not yet on certified-renewable grid power, Americas glass returns at 31% vs a 50% target, Scope 3 ingredient logistics unmeasured. Same letter, same place, every year.
